source.dataset: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist
source.sampling: Deterministic evenly spaced rows within each time-sorted, pre-established train and holdout set.
source.precision: Source numeric inputs and duration labels rounded to six decimal places; no measurements synthesized.
source.timestamps: Cutoffs use the preparation pipeline's UTC-normalized representation of source-naive timestamps; the source timezone is not established.
source.scope: Historical delivered-order cohort. The browser sample is not the complete Olist study or a representative population sample.

split.label_availability: Training labels must have become available strictly before the test cutoff; pending labels are purged.
split.preprocessing: Imputation, scaling and encoding fitted on training rows only.

limitations: These are sampled historical orders, not the full-cohort benchmark.
Model settings are fixed in advance; the holdout is not for tuning.
Use training rows only to fit imputers, scaling and estimators.
Selection includes delivered orders only and excludes canceled or undelivered outcomes.
